Hotel Equities Earns Fourth Consecutive #1 Ranking as Marriott’s Top Performing Franchise Management Company Based on Intent to Recommend (ITR) Scores 

### Hotel Equities Earns Fourth Consecutive #1 Ranking as Marriott’s Top Performing Franchise Management Company Based on Intent to Recommend (ITR) Scores 

 August 14, 2026 

ATLANTA, GA – Hotel Equities (“HE”), a best-in-class hospitality operator and developer, has once again earned the #1 ranking as Marriott’s Top Performing Franchise Management Company (FMC) in the U.S. and Canada for Q2 2026 among management companies operating 51 or more Marriott Select Brand (MSB) hotels, based on Intent to Recommend (ITR) scores.

The latest recognition marks Hotel Equities’ fourth consecutive time earning the #1 ranking, demonstrating sustained leadership in one of Marriott’s most important measures of guest satisfaction and loyalty.

The achievement carries even greater significance for hotel owners following Marriott International’s recent announcement of a new ITR incentive program designed to financially reward eligible hotels that achieve strong guest satisfaction scores. Under the program, qualifying hotels may receive rebates of up to 50 basis points of gross room revenue, funded directly from Marriott’s profit and loss statement rather than shared system funds.

“ITR has always been more than a guest satisfaction score for us,” said David Rosenberg, President, Focused Service Division for HE. “It’s an operating metric that tells us whether we’re getting the fundamentals right at the hotel level. Now, with Marriott putting a direct financial incentive behind ITR performance, the connection between the guest experience and owner returns is even more tangible. For owners, that makes consistent execution incredibly important. Earning the number-one ranking four consecutive times across a portfolio of our size demonstrates that our results are repeatable and scalable, not isolated to a handful of high-performing hotels. We’ve built the systems, accountability and operating discipline to keep ITR at the forefront, and our teams understand that every guest interaction ultimately contributes to the performance and value of the asset.”

With ITR performance now carrying an even more direct financial benefit for qualifying owners, a management company’s ability to consistently drive guest satisfaction has never been more consequential.

Intent to Recommend, or ITR, is a key Marriott performance measure reflecting guest loyalty, satisfaction and brand advocacy. Hotel Equities’ sustained leadership in ITR reflects the company’s commitment to operational excellence and its ability to translate a people-first culture into measurable performance across a large and diverse portfolio.

### Hotel Equities New CEO, Ben Rafter, Charts Path 

 June 04, 2025 

NEW YORK CITY – New Hotel Equities CEO Ben Rafter says word on the street is that management company business practices are stale. In the next breath, he said the recent merger of his old Springboard Hospitality with HE does create something different – a hotel operating company for the first time run by a tech-forward executive with a heavy focus on revenue generation now fused with an historical operating company. “If this isn’t reinventing a management company, I don’t know what is,” Rafter told Hotel Investment Today during an interview at the NYU investment conference earlier this week.

Rafter added that HE is going to get more aggressive with growth, but not growth for growth’s sake, and mostly led by organic opportunities. Read the full Hotel Investment Today article here.

Hotel Equities Announces Three Key Promotions to Executive Leadership Team ATLANTA, GA – May 28, 2024 – Hotel owner, operator, and developer, Hotel Equities (“HE”), is pleased to announce the promotion of three senior leaders to support the firm's elevated performance and growth.

David Rosenberg has been promoted to Executive Vice President of Operations, reflecting his exceptional 
performance since joining HE in 2020. David's expertise in analytics-driven decision-making and operational 
efficiency has been instrumental in elevating the company's portfolio performance. David will continue to support 
a significant portfolio and HE’s growing shared services discipline while championing the use of analytics to drive 
operational excellence across all facets of HE’s operations. 
Peter Tziahanas has also been promoted to Executive Vice President of Operations, recognizing his impact, 
leadership and extensive experience in full service and lifestyle hotel operations. Since joining HE in 2021, Peter 
has driven performance and heightened engagement with HE’s stakeholders at all levels. His focus on operational 
excellence within the company’s full service and lifestyle division has firmly established HE as a leader in the 
upscale and resort segment of the industry. 
Toi Brown has been elevated to the position of Senior Vice President of Human Resources. Toi has led various 
initiatives for HE since joining the firm in 2018. Under her leadership, HE’s focus on associate wellness and 
benefits, risk mitigation and regulatory compliance continues to be a differentiator for HE. Toi is a member of both 
the Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM) and the Association for Talent Development (ATD). 
"These promotions within our executive leadership team represent HE’s ongoing commitment to developing 
internal talent, each of these servant leaders are best in class and deliver exceptional support and results for all of 
our stakeholders," said HE Chief Operating Officer, Bryan DeCort. 
For more information about Career opportunities at Hotel Equities, please visit hotelequities.com/careers. 
About Hotel Equities 
Hotel Equities (HE) is an award-winning full-scale hotel ownership, management, and development firm with a 
portfolio of approximately 300 hotels and resorts throughout the United States and Canada. Fred Cerrone, CHA, 
serves as Founder and Chairman; Brad Rahinsky serves as President and CEO. For more information on Hotel 
Equities, visit hotelequities.com.
